params.name: collectionId
params.description:
Names or concept ids of the UMM-Var variables to be retrieved, or "all" to retrieve all variables within the CMR collection(s).
Multiple variables may be retrieved by separating them with a comma.  This API interprets OGC "collections" to be
equivalent to CMR "variables" which produces some overloading in the name.  In this document, a "collection" is
a CMR / UMM-Var variable and a "CMR collection" is a CMR / UMM-C collection.

params.description:

params.name: outputcrs
params.description: reproject the output coverage to the given CRS.  Recognizes CRS types that can be inferred by gdal, including EPSG codes, Proj4 strings, and OGC URLs (http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/...)

params.name: subset
params.description:
get a subset of the coverage by slicing or trimming among one axis.  Harmony supports the axes "lat" and "lon" for spatial subsetting, and "time" for temporal, regardless of the names of those axes in the data files. Harmony also supports arbitrary dimension names for subsetting on numeric ranges for that dimension.
Examples: - Subset to the lat/lon bounding box with southwest corner (-10, -10) and northeast corner (10, 10) subset=lat(-10:10)&subset=lon(-10:10) - Subset to all latitudes north of -10 degrees and all longitudes west of 10 degrees subset=lat(-10:*)&subset=lon(*:10) - Subset to only points with latitudes from -10 to 10 degrees, disregarding longitude subset=lat(-10:10) - Subset to the first month of 2020 subset=time("2020-01-01T00:00:00Z":"2020-02-01T00:00:00Z") - Subset on arbitrary dimension "vertical" with a value between 0 and 20 subset=vertical(0:20)
For full syntax and examples, see https://github.com/opengeospatial/ogc_api_coverages/blob/master/standard/clause_9_subset.adoc

params.name: interpolation
params.description: specify the interpolation method used during reprojection and scaling

params.name: scaleExtent
params.description: scale the resulting coverage either among one axis to a given extent

params.name: scaleSize
params.description: scale the resulting coverage either among one axis to a given size

params.name: concatenate
params.description: requests results to be concatenated into a single result

params.name: granuleId
params.description: The CMR Granule ID for the granule which should be retrieved

params.name: point
params.description:
Only collections that have a geometry that contains a spatial point are selected. The spatial point is provided as two numbers:
* Longitude, coordinate axis 1 * Latitude, coordinate axis 2
The coordinate reference system of the values is WGS84 longitude/latitude (http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/OGC/1.3/CRS84).

params.name: width
params.description: number of columns to return in the output coverage

params.name: height
params.description: number of rows to return in the output coverage

params.name: format
params.description: the output mime type to return

params.name: forceAsync
params.description: if "true", override the default API behavior and always treat the request as asynchronous

params.name: serviceId
params.description: Either the CMR concept ID or the name in services.yml for the UMM-S service chain to invoke. Useful for testing a service chain against a collection not yet configured for use with that service chain.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: limits the number of input granules processed in the request

params.name: skipPreview
params.description: if "true", override the default API behavior and never auto-pause jobs

params.name: ignoreErrors
params.description:
if "true", continue processing a request to completion even if some items fail. If "false",
immediately fail the request on the first failure. Defaults to true.

params.name: destinationUrl
params.description:
destination url specified by the client, currently only s3 link url is supported
(e.g. s3://my-bucket-name/mypath) and will result in the job being run asynchronously

params.name: granuleName
params.description:
passed to the CMR search as the readable_granule_name parameter. Supports * and ? wildcards
for multiple and single character matches. Wildcards can be used any place in the name,
but leading wildcards are discouraged as they require a lot of resources for the underlying
search.

params.name: grid
params.description:
the name of the output grid to use for regridding requests. The name must match the UMM
grid name in the CMR.

params.name: extend
params.description: the name or concept id of the variable to extend

params.name: variable
params.description: the names or concept ids of the variables to subset

params.name: average
params.description: requests the data to be averaged over time or area

params.name: label
params.description: the labels for the job

params.name: pixelSubset
params.description: if "true", pixel subset will be performed by the service
